Quantum 1.20.0 was certified on 2026-08-28. It pins **nucleus v1.15.1**, **quark v1.6.1** and **orbit v1.8.3**, with 6 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.19.0: nucleus goes from v1.14.0 to v1.15.1 (minor), orbit goes from v1.8.1 to v1.8.3 (patch) and quark stays at v1.6.1. 4 sibling modules change version.
